integrity: The complete forty-tetrahedron complex is embedded. Ambient H2 over F2 is reconstructed from boundary matrices; every vertex subset of size at most six is exhaustively checked; every one of the twenty minimizers is verified to be an induced closed six-vertex projective plane; and the full 48-element simplicial automorphism group is independently enumerated.
scientific_limitations: The finding is mod-two and specific to the published eleven-vertex labelled triangulation of RP3. It classifies only minimum induced vertex supports, not larger supports or non-induced embedded surfaces.
title: Twenty induced projective planes are the shortest mod-two \(H_2\)-carriers in Walkup's eleven-vertex \(\mathbb{RP}^3\)
